subject: Syndicated index onboarding — retainer & scope discussion
messages:
From: Tom Harrington <tom@pinecone.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@atlasdata.io>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Syndicated index onboarding — retainer & scope proposal

Hi Soojin,

Great to meet at the Data Partners Summit last week. Per our conversation, Pinecone is interested in a joint onboarding retainer with Redwood for a small set of co-syndicated customers where we provide index tenancy and optimizations and Redwood owns inference routing and quality guardrails.

I attached a short draft SOW that outlines a two-month retainer (discovery + integration + pilot) and a follow-on optional quarterly support plan. Key asks from our side:
- 6 hours/week of Redwood engineering for connector hardening (pgvector + s3 fallback)
- Two joint success metrics: end-to-end 99th percentile response < 350ms and retrieval precision > 88% on provided evals
- A named point of contact for procurement and security questionnaires

Can we sync on a short call this week to align commercial assumptions and who on each team will own the technical checklist? Maya from AtlasData (cc'd) is our systems integrator and will be the delivery partner for two pilot customers.

Thanks,
Tom

--
Tom Harrington
Partnerships, Pinecone
Attachment: 20280611-pinecone-draft-sow.pdf (application/pdf, 78KB)

Tom — thanks, appreciate the concise SOW. Happy to run this through our GTM/partnerships workflow. Quick notes:
- I can be the Redwood delivery lead for the commercial discussion; Ben will own the connector technical scope and integration acceptance criteria.
- The two metrics you propose are reasonable; we usually set a small buffer on latency during the pilot to protect customers while we tune KV cache and batching.
- Procurement/security: please send your standard SOC2/SSO requirements; we have a standard vendor checklist but may need a short exception for joint pilots.

Call times: I'm available Wed 6/13 10–11am PT or Thu 6/14 2–4pm PT. Which works for you and Maya?

Soojin

Adding a few technical questions ahead of the call so we can keep the discussion focused:

1) Connector delta: are we shipping a managed Pinecone connector (hosted) or a connector we will install in customer VPCs (self-hosted pgvector adapter)? The SOW implies both. We should be explicit about installation, egress, and service accounts.
2) Data residency: for the two pilot customers one requires EU data residency for embeddings and vector storage; can Pinecone confirm region availability and whether the retainer covers cross-region replication costs?
3) Failure modes: propose acceptance tests for index failover (simulate node OOM, cold-tier spillover to S3) — we need a runbook entry.

I've attached a short Redwood onboarding checklist (internal template) and an initial acceptance criteria draft for the connector. If you can ACK the top-level assumptions we can lock the SOW line items.

Ben
Senior Product Manager, Embed Ops — Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Syndicated index onboarding — retainer & scope proposal

Thanks Ben — good, concrete questions. Short replies inline: 
1) Connector model: for the pilot we propose a hybrid approach — Pinecone provides hosted index tenancy but will deliver an installer for a lightweight routing adapter customers can run in VPCs that talks to Pinecone under the customer's account. This lets us meet data residency needs while keeping index performance centralized.
2) Regions: Pinecone can provision EU tenants for the pilot; the retainer covers up to two region-provisioning actions. Cross-region replication costs would be on a consumption basis; we modeled a conservative estimate in the SOW addendum.
3) Failure tests: agreed — we'll co-author a shared runbook. We can add a test matrix to the acceptance criteria.

Attached: updated SOW with a short commercial appendix and the cost model. I highlighted the two line items that map to Ben's asks.

Tom
--

- For procurement: we'll need a sample MSSA and schedule of fees for the retainer and optional quarterly support.

We're available for Thu 6/14 2pm PT. If that time works for Redwood and Pinecone let's lock it and I can share a short onboarding plan for the two pilot customers.
